subject: Exp. Share
claim: After delivering Steven's Letter, return to Mr. Stone at Devon Corporation in Rustboro City for an Exp. Share.
source_note: Use in Ruby, Sapphire and Emerald, checked against the Letter article; does not apply to the remakes.

subject: Exp. Share
claim: Speak to Rowan's assistant in Route 206's northern gate after registering at least 35 Pokémon as seen in your Pokédex to receive an Exp. Share.
source_note: The item row is marked D/P/Pt, not BD/SP. The requirement is seen, not caught.

subject: Exp. All
claim: In these originals the item is called Exp. All. Oak's aide gives it on the second floor of the Route 15 gate after you have obtained 50 Pokémon species.
source_note: Original international Red/Blue/Yellow row; the item is carried in the Bag, not held.

subject: Exp. Share
claim: Oak's aide gives you an Exp. Share upstairs in the Route 15 gate after you have obtained 50 Pokémon species.
source_note: FireRed/LeafGreen acquisition row, kept separate from the original Exp. All.
